description: Li ion diffusion coefficient D(T), activation energy Ea, and Nernst-Einstein conductivity σ from AIMD-MLIP at multiple temperatures.

method_notes.aimd_mlip: Born-Oppenheimer MD with foundation MLIP (UMA-s-1p1, task=omat) on DFT-relaxed V0 structure. Langevin NVT thermostat, 2 fs timestep, equilibrate 10 ps + production 100 ps per T. Trajectory saved every 100 fs.
method_notes.msd_fit: Linear regression MSD = 6 D t in the diffusive regime (2-50 ps).
method_notes.arrhenius: ln(D) = ln(D0) - Ea/(kB T) fit across all measured T.
method_notes.nernst_einstein: σ_NE = n_Li z² e² D* / (kB T) using the TRACER D* (from MSD), assuming Haven ratio H_R = D*/D_σ = 1 (uncorrelated hopping). True σ = n_Li z² e² D_σ/(kB T) = σ_NE / H_R; for SE H_R ≈ 0.3-0.7 (<1, concerted motion) so the TRUE intrinsic σ is HIGHER than the H_R=1 estimate. H_R=1 is therefore a conservative lower bound and does NOT explain why σ_NE sits above measured pellet values.
method_notes.caveats: Foundation MLIP (UMA-s-1p1) tends to overestimate Li transport by 3-5× vs experiment for LPSCl family. Ea is more robust than absolute σ. 300 K extrapolation from 600-1000 K Arrhenius has additional uncertainty if non-Arrhenius behavior exists near room T (rare for LPSCl).

results.method: UMA-s-1p1 (task=omat) AIMD, Langevin NVT 600/800/1000 K, 100 ps prod each

diffusion_per_T._note: Cl/P/S diffusion ~ 5x lower than Li → framework immobile, Li-only conductor ✓

arrhenius_fit.sigma_NE_300K_Scm_estimate: ~14e-3 (= 14 mS/cm) using n_Li ≈ 2.22e22 cm⁻³ from V0

vs_experiment.sigma_overestimate_attribution: Dominated by (1) foundation MLIP overshoot of Li diffusivity D* (~2-5x, typical for UMA on LPSCl) and (2) bulk-vs-pellet: MD = perfect single-crystal bulk, experiment = cold-pressed pellet with grain-boundary/porosity resistance (lower). NOTE the H_R=1 assumption is the OPPOSITE sign: real H_R<1 gives true intrinsic σ = σ_NE/H_R HIGHER, so Haven does NOT account for the over-experiment overshoot.

results._status: ★ Nd2O3-doped modelc transport (2026-06-17, V100 UMA-MLIP). CAVEAT: UMA Nd-4f transferability unverified → cite RATIO vs modelc + Ea direction, not absolute sigma.
results.method: UMA-s-1p1 (task=omat) MLIP MD, Langevin NVT 600/800/1000 K, prod each. EXACT same protocol as comp1/modelc. V100.

comparison_robust.Ea_vs_modelc: nd 0.227 ≈ modelc 0.224 (Δ+0.003) — barrier UNCHANGED by Nd+O. Both < comp1 0.253.
comparison_robust.D_ratio_nd_over_modelc: 0.62 (600-1000K), 0.58 (300K extrap) — Nd+O lowers Li diffusivity to ~62% of modelc.
comparison_robust.sigma300_ratio_nd_over_modelc: 0.52 (= D ratio 0.58 × n_Li ratio 0.90). nd 7.3 vs modelc 14 mS/cm; nd still > comp1 3.35.
comparison_robust.mechanism: σ300 ratio (nd/modelc) 0.52 DECOMPOSES into three multiplicative factors: D0 prefactor 0.65 (nd 3.78e-4 vs modelc 5.80e-4) × n_Li carriers 0.90 (2.00 vs 2.22e22) × Ea barrier factor 0.88 (exp[-(0.227-0.224)/kT@300]). 0.65×0.90×0.88=0.52 ✓. DOMINANT driver = D0 PREFACTOR reduction — Nd3+ + O@PS4 narrows Li pathways / lowers attempt frequency. Carrier reduction (Nd3+/O2- Li-vacancy compensation) secondary; barrier essentially UNCHANGED (negligible Ea factor).

D0_prefactor_3way_cm2_per_s._note: nd D0 LOWEST — Nd+O reduces the attempt-frequency/pathway prefactor below even ordered LPSCl. modelc highest (vacancy-rich, more open pathways).

comparison_robust.experimental_validation: Matches La+O co-doping (Electrochim. Acta 2025, doi 10.1016/j.electacta.2025.146619): exp sigma 9.58→6.23 mS/cm = 0.65× on La3+ + O. Our Nd3++O DFT-MLIP gives 0.52× — same direction, similar magnitude. Trivalent-lanthanide + O co-doping reduces sigma ~0.5-0.65×.

results.caveat: UMA Nd-4f transferability unverified (4f sparse in MLIP training). ROBUST claims: Ea direction + nd/modelc D & sigma ratio. Absolute sigma carries usual UMA 3-5× overshoot PLUS Nd-4f uncertainty — do NOT cite 7.29 mS/cm as absolute.

mechanism_interpretation_v2_2026_06_11.paper_message: σ(LPSCl1.6) > σ(LPSCl) is NOT 'prefactor only' (our earlier 5fu-based reading) NOR 'barrier only' (Minafra simplification). It's BOTH — Cl-rich/vacancy structure simultaneously flattens the Li hopping landscape (Ea↓ via 4d-Cl AS distorting cage) AND increases mobile carrier concentration (vacancy + Cl-substituted sites).
